subject: VALUE clause
notes: kb/Work PB560 (verdict unchanged, LANDED) - TEST-REF REPAIRED IN THE CHANGE SET THAT RENAMED THE TEST (kb/Work PB920). The drift test this row rests on asserted the §13.18.63.3 SR6 edited-image composer had exactly TWO readers; PB920's fix makes the BINDER a third, DELIBERATELY - §13.18.63.3 SR26 and SR27 compare "the value of" two VALUE-clause operands, and on a numeric-edited subject that value IS the edited image, so a screen that composed its own would be the very drift the test exists to catch. The assertion was therefore renamed to TheNumericEditedValueImage_HasExactlyThreeReaders with the third reader named in its own doc comment, and a second assertion, TheNumericEditedValueImage_IsPhaseNeutral, pins the signature that keeps the composer callable from binding (it takes (dialectLevel, decimalPointIsComma), never an EmitContext - an EmitContext parameter is exactly how a second copy of SR6 gets written). Both are named here so this row's evidence follows the rename rather than pointing at a method that no longer exists, which SpecTraceabilityInventoryDriftTests.EveryTestRef_ResolvesToARealTest caught at the gate.
